mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'

The project's current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception for internal hosts: connections to internal hosts use HTTPS like any others, on the basis that certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
